subtitle_alignment: Scene-anchored phrases, duration proportional to word count; not forced word alignment.

scenes.screen: The shop is closed. The spreadsheets are still open. QuietOps makes that search a short review queue, with evidence and a draft ready for your decision.
scenes.text: The shop is closed. The spreadsheets are still open. QuietOps makes that search a short review queue, with evidence and a draft ready for your decision.

scenes.screen: Start with the original fictional shop. Deterministic checks find stock-cover risks, late deliveries, and invoice candidates. These findings remain separate from the new predictive review.
scenes.text: Start with the original fictional shop. Deterministic checks find stock-cover risks, late deliveries, and invoice candidates. These findings remain separate from the new predictive review.

scenes.screen: Predictions need history. The original files contain one stock snapshot. This optional example adds explicitly synthetic dated snapshots and earlier sales, preserving the originals.
scenes.text: Predictions need history. The original files contain one stock snapshot. This optional example adds explicitly synthetic dated snapshots and earlier sales, preserving the originals.

scenes.screen: Run real Tab P F N inference locally. It estimates whether sales during supplier lead time could exceed stock, assuming no receipt. Failed inference never gets a substitute score.
scenes.text: Run real Tab P F N inference locally. It estimates whether sales during supplier lead time could exceed stock, assuming no receipt. Failed inference never gets a substitute score.

scenes.screen: Rolled oats shows the disagreement. Both simple baselines show cover, but the model estimates about eighty-four percent risk. This recurring-demand illustration was selected after exploring model outputs; it is not an independent test.
scenes.text: Rolled oats shows the disagreement. Both simple baselines show cover, but the model estimates about eighty-four percent risk. This recurring-demand illustration was selected after exploring model outputs; it is not an independent test.

scenes.screen: The separate historical holdout uses earlier training and later test dates. On two hundred and forty synthetic examples, model F one reached ninety-seven percent, against sixty-five and seventy-two for the baselines.
scenes.text: The separate historical holdout uses earlier training and later test dates. On two hundred and forty synthetic examples, model F one reached ninety-seven percent, against sixty-five and seventy-two for the baselines.

scenes.screen: Inspect the stock snapshot and both sales files. Originals stay downloadable. Estimates are uncalibrated, and sales can hide demand lost during stockouts. Real shop performance remains unproven.
scenes.text: Inspect the stock snapshot and both sales files. Originals stay downloadable. Estimates are uncalibrated, and sales can hide demand lost during stockouts. Real shop performance remains unproven.

scenes.screen: Now ask local Ministral to explain the supplied prediction. Tab P F N provides the probability. Ministral explains the facts and suggests a review step, while guards check source references, numbers, and uncertain wording.
scenes.text: Now ask local Ministral to explain the supplied prediction. Tab P F N provides the probability. Ministral explains the facts and suggests a review step, while guards check source references, numbers, and uncertain wording.

scenes.screen: Create a supplier-review draft and edit the wording. Confirm the delivery plan and current stock before considering a purchase. The draft still needs a human decision.
scenes.text: Create a supplier-review draft and edit the wording. Confirm the delivery plan and current stock before considering a purchase. The draft still needs a human decision.

scenes.screen: Approve for manual export. QuietOps sends no message and places no order. Changed data or a new scan date makes predictive drafts stale, blocking approval and export until the evidence is reviewed again.
scenes.text: Approve for manual export. QuietOps sends no message and places no order. Changed data or a new scan date makes predictive drafts stale, blocking approval and export until the evidence is reviewed again.

scenes.screen: Open models keep inference and shop files on your machine after setup. The measured results come from synthetic data, with no claim of saved minutes. Less searching, a clearer next step, and you stay in charge.
